data.name: The Furry Protocol
data.detailed_description:
You are a Soviet programmer working for a state-owned company. One day, you decide to sign a contract to participate in a project to modify the human body.

After signing the contract, you are put into cryosleep for an indefinite period of time. After almost half a century, you wake up in your cryopod. You are completely alone, confused, and trying to find someone.

As you walk down the hallway, you find the dead bodies of the complex's staff. Something clearly happened during your sleep, but you don't know what it was. What was the company doing for almost half a century, and what caused the complex to collapse?

Horror elements

  • The game will immerse you in an atmosphere of horror. During the passage, you will find yourself in a variety of rooms that were filled with life not so long ago and now tell the stories of the collapse of the underground complex, the death of its workers and how it was overrun by monsters.

    Monster design. The monsters in the game are former humans, the virus caused them to mutate by changing their bodies. Some monsters have severely deformed limbs, an open chest, the absence of some organs or the presence of additional ones.

Gameplay

  • The gameplay is tied to the study of locations in stealth. You have to hack the security systems of the complex, study various documents and read audiologs to figure out what the company has been doing for a little over forty years.

  • You will also go through cybernetic modifications of the body, which will allow you to acquire new abilities.

Mature content

The game features murder scenes, grievous bodily harm, regular violent acts, and blood.

data.short_description: Survive and escape from the scientific research complex in the Siberian forests and uncover the secrets of the corporation that built this complex.
data.supported_languages:
English, Russian*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX580 or NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6gb
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX6600 or NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
